content.title: App Setup Guide
content.description: Complete guide to setting up Unetwork on your mobile device and start earning network incentives.
requirements: A supported Android or iOS smartphone
A stable internet connection (Wi-Fi or mobile data)
Access to your email address (for email sign-in) and/or access to a Web3 wallet (for wallet sign-in and crypto redemption)

steps.title: Welcome to Unetwork
steps.description: Open the Unetwork app to see the welcome screen. Generate Network Incentives by Verifying the Telecom Grid from Your Mobile Phone. Click 'GET STARTED' to proceed.

steps.title: Choose Your Role
steps.description:
Select how you want to use Unetwork:

- **Node Operator**: Manage nodes and licenses you own on-chain.
- **License Operator**: Operate a single or multiple licenses.
- **Claim a License**: Explore the marketplace to choose and claim yours.

steps.title: Access Your Leased License
steps.description: If you selected 'License Operator', enter your lease code to continue. If you don't have a lease code, tap 'Skip' to continue without one.

steps.title: Choose Sign-In Method
steps.description:
Select how you want to access Unetwork:

- **Sign in with Web3**: Use your crypto wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect, or Coinbase) to manage licenses.
- **Sign in with Email**: Use your email address to manage licenses.

steps.title: Sign In with Email
steps.description: To manage your leased license, sign in with your email. Enter your email address and we'll send you a one-time code to continue. Click 'CONTINUE' after entering your email.

steps.title: Verify Your Code
steps.description: We've sent a one-time code to your email. Enter the OTP code to confirm your identity and continue to your account. Click 'VERIFY' to complete sign-in.

steps.title: License Claimed Successfully
steps.description: Congratulations! You have successfully claimed this License. Click 'CONTINUE' to proceed to your dashboard.

steps.title: Dashboard Overview
steps.description:
Welcome to your Unetwork dashboard! Here you can see:

- **Total Network Incentives**: Your cumulative earnings
- **Earnings**: Today's earnings and Last 7 Days summary
- **Proof of Work Status**: Service Status, Switch Node, Validation Node connection states
- **License Details**: Your license ID, activation status, lease duration, and required uptime (97% daily)

es.title: Guía de Configuración de la App
es.description: Guía completa para configurar Unetwork en tu dispositivo móvil y comenzar a ganar incentivos de red.

steps.title: Bienvenido a Unetwork
steps.description: Abre la app de Unetwork para ver la pantalla de bienvenida. Genera Incentivos de Red verificando la Red de Telecomunicaciones desde tu teléfono móvil. Haz clic en 'COMENZAR' para continuar.

steps.title: Elige tu Rol
steps.description:
Selecciona cómo quieres usar Unetwork:

- **Operador de Nodo**: Gestiona nodos y licencias que posees en la blockchain.
- **Operador de Licencia**: Opera una o múltiples licencias.
- **Reclamar una Licencia**: Explora el marketplace para elegir y reclamar la tuya.

ar.title: دليل إعداد التطبيق
ar.description: دليل شامل لإعداد Unetwork على جهازك المحمول والبدء في كسب حوافز الشبكة.

steps.title: مرحباً بك في Unetwork
steps.description: افتح تطبيق Unetwork لرؤية شاشة الترحيب. اكسب حوافز الشبكة من خلال التحقق من شبكة الاتصالات من هاتفك المحمول. انقر على 'ابدأ' للمتابعة.

content.title: License Operator
content.description: Operate a single or multiple licenses to earn network incentives. Manage your leased licenses and start generating rewards by verifying the telecom grid.
requirements: Stable internet connection (Wi-Fi or Mobile Data)

es.title: Operador de Licencia
es.description: Opera una o múltiples licencias para ganar incentivos de red. Gestiona tus licencias arrendadas y comienza a generar recompensas verificando la red de telecomunicaciones.

ar.title: مشغل الترخيص
ar.description: قم بتشغيل ترخيص واحد أو أكثر لكسب حوافز الشبكة. إدارة التراخيص المؤجرة الخاصة بك والبدء في توليد المكافآت من خلال التحقق من شبكة الاتصالات.

content.title: Node Operator
content.description: Manage nodes and licenses you own on-chain. As a Node Operator, you have full control over your blockchain assets and can maximize your network incentive earnings.

content.title: Claim a License
content.description: Explore the Unetwork License Marketplace to choose and claim your license. Browse available licenses, check uptime requirements, and start earning network incentives.
